name: Face Mask
description: TSA rules for face masks on planes.

carryOn.reason: Face masks of all types (surgical, N95, KN95, cloth, disposable) are fully allowed in carry-on and checked baggage. Airlines may have their own mask policies.

checkedBag.reason: Face masks are allowed in checked baggage.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring face masks on a plane?

travelTips: Carry extra face masks in your personal bag — some international destinations may still require them

faq.question: Can I bring face masks on a plane?
faq.answer: Yes, face masks of all types are fully allowed in carry-on and checked baggage with no restrictions.

faq.question: Are N95 masks allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Yes, N95 and KN95 respirators are allowed in carry-on bags. You can pack as many as you need.
